name: Should I get a roof maintenance assessment before buying a new home in the DFW area?

mainEntity.name: Should I get a roof maintenance assessment before buying a new home in the DFW area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is highly recommended to get a roof maintenance assessment before purchasing a new home in the DFW area. A pre-purchase assessment can uncover hidden issues like storm damage, aging materials, or improper repairs that might not be visible during a general home inspection. Identifying these problems early can allow you to negotiate repairs with the seller or factor potential costs into your budget. We frequently find pre-existing hail damage in homes throughout the DFW metroplex.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a pre-purchase roof maintenance assessment in DFW is highly recommended to uncover hidden issues like storm damage and inform negotiations.
